d: Very long, flowing platinum blonde hair with straight bangs and a voluminous, wavy texture. Slanted, narrow purple eyes with a mischievous expression on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build wearing a short, off-the-shoulder white dress with a light blue waist accent, paired with white lace-up sandals and dark blue garter straps on the thighs. Signature details include two curved, black ram-like horns protruding from the head and a large, black three-pronged trident topped with purple flames.
